title: Amretri Healthcare

title: JaiSathya Inc.
role: Lead Full-Stack Architect & Visual CMS Engineer
tagline: Founder-Led Multi-Vertical Holding Ecosystem with Live Visual CMS
summary: Full-scale corporate platform engineered for a multi-vertical US holding company — featuring an innovative in-place Visual CMS that lets non-technical stakeholders edit text, imagery, and layout directly on the live rendered website canvas.
description: JaiSathya Inc. is a US-based, founder-led holding company operating eight diverse business verticals across North America — including flagship restaurants (Manam, Kaanchi, Malgudi Cafe), food distribution, real estate assets, wellness meal kits (Ayuryum), brand consulting, DataEQ enterprise governance technology, and The Philadelphians professional cricket club.

Engineered a bespoke, state-of-the-art Visual CMS from scratch. Unlike traditional CMS dashboards with disconnected forms or rigid section-by-section fields, this custom administrative engine enables the client to edit copy, media assets, and structural blocks directly from the actual live website design with instantaneous live preview and seamless persistence.

Built a high-performance web architecture supporting multiple multi-brand portals, high-fidelity media pipelines via Cloudinary, and enterprise data governance showcases with sub-second page delivery across all viewports.

features.title: Direct Visual In-Place CMS
features.desc: Empowers the client to click and edit any text, image, or brand showcase directly on the live visual layout without separate admin forms.

features.title: Multi-Vertical Holding Architecture
features.desc: Unified digital presence orchestrating 8 distinct business units across hospitality, technology, real estate, and sports.

features.title: Optimized Media Pipeline
features.desc: Real-time Cloudinary image transforms, responsive picture sets, and high-DPI asset delivery for stunning visual fidelity.

features.title: Enterprise Security & Performance
features.desc: Role-based administrative authentication, granular content revision control, and sub-second load times.

Multi-brand corporate architecture connecting hospitality, sports, real estate, and tech
Automated Cloudinary media pipeline and asset optimization

title: Carspace
tagline: Real-Time Second-Hand Automobile Marketplace with Zero-Install PWA
summary: High-performance hybrid e-commerce marketplace for certified pre-owned vehicles — engineered with sub-100ms multi-facet inventory search, real-time Firestore database synchronization, and native-feeling offline PWA mobile capabilities.
description: Used car marketplaces frequently suffer from sluggish inventory indexing, outdated pricing states, and heavy app download barriers for casual car buyers. Carspace was conceived to eliminate this friction through an instantaneous, app-like web platform connecting certified dealerships with prospective buyers.

Engineered the full-stack architecture on React and Firebase Cloud Firestore. Implemented client-side indexing and real-time document listeners that push vehicle availability, price adjustments, and inspection status updates across all connected clients in under 100 milliseconds without page refreshes.

Architected the application as an installable Progressive Web App (PWA) with smart service worker caching strategies, enabling seamless offline browsing of previously viewed car models, smooth touch gestures, and full home-screen installability across iOS and Android.

features.title: Sub-100ms Faceted Search
features.desc: Ultra-fast multi-parameter query engine allowing simultaneous instant filtering across make, model, odometer mileage, price bracket, and transmission type.

features.title: Real-Time Firestore Inventory Sync
features.desc: Live websocket-backed document updates that automatically reflect newly listed vehicles, sold reservations, and price changes without reloading.

features.title: Zero-Install PWA Mobile Parity
features.desc: Installable to mobile home screens with service worker offline caching, responsive touch gestures, and native app appearance.

features.title: Dealership & Buyer Inquiry Flow
features.desc: Streamlined in-app direct inquiry pipeline connecting verified buyers to dealership representatives with one-tap WhatsApp and call actions.

highlights: High-speed multi-faceted vehicle filtering with sub-100ms response time
Real-time cloud database architecture powered by Firebase Firestore
Installable Progressive Web App with offline caching and native mobile UI
Streamlined dealership contact routing and vehicle inspection badges
